# Atom UI

Atom UI is an accessible, headless React primitive library and the behavioral foundation beneath Brick.

## Canonical resources

- [Website](https://atom-ui.com/)
- [Documentation overview](https://atom-ui.com/docs/)
- [Getting started](https://atom-ui.com/docs/overview/getting-started/)
- [Accessibility](https://atom-ui.com/docs/overview/accessibility/)
- [Primitive catalog](https://atom-ui.com/docs/components/)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/flowstack-ui/atom)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@flowstack-ui/atom)
